sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio. All photos and videos to be attached to the end-of-shift report.

Debrief completed; suiting up for deployment and patrols.

Welfare check at Starbucks Queen Street, all clear.
Welfare check at Lotus Foreign Exchange, Nike, Cotton On, Habits Vietnamese Cafe and Eatery, Localito Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street and Ms Higgins, all clear. Standing by to show presence to oncoming foot traffic arriving for morning coffee and meals.
Arrived at check-in Skyworld Entertainment Centre; full sweep around the area, all clear.
Walkthrough between the Bledisloe Building alleyway and Skyworld Entertainment Centre, all clear.

Ending Alpha Route and commencing Delta Route.
Arrived at check-in Commercial Bay, all clear.
Welfare check on stores along Customs Street East, all clear:
Walkthrough of Fort Lane with welfare checks on stores, all clear:

Welfare check at Coco Lane, all clear:
Welfare check on stores along Lorne Street, all clear:

Welfare check at Bentto, Choice Plaza, Sushiya, Choice Backpackers Wellesley Street East, all clear.
Arrived at check-in corner of Rutland Street and Wakefield Street, all clear.
Queens Food Court and all restaurants within
Tanuki Japanese Sake and Sushi Bar

Welfare check at Jack's Fried Chicken, Jack's Cafeteria, The Terrace, Aotea Centre, Cafe and Bar, all clear.
Arrived at check-in Aotea Square, all clear. Ending Delta Route and commencing Echo Route.
Response call from Lovisa — a couple committed theft and left towards the bus stop in front of the store; assistance requested to trace them and retrieve the items.
Arrived at the response call; the individuals had already left. Described as wearing black Nike jackets and green Adidas shoes, of Polynesian or Māori descent.

Welfare check and sweep through Wilson Carpark, Elliott Street, towards Albert Street.
Welfare check at Mr Barbers, City Convenience Store, Peppers Cafe, all clear.
Welfare check and walkthrough via the escalators through to SkyCity Casino, Federal Street, all clear.
Welfare check at The Fed, Glass Goose, Weta Workshop, Eighty Fed, all clear.

Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store, Coffee Club, Roma Blooms, Accord Barbershop, Subway, all clear.
Welfare check at Izmir Kebab and Grill, Little Tiger Dumpling, Kiwi Souvenirs, Amelia Cafe, Printshop, all clear.
Welfare check at 1947 Eatery and People's Barista, all clear.
Walkthrough and welfare check of Canterbury Arcade, all clear.
Response message from management to attend High Street Supermarket (Vulcan Lane) regarding a theft that had already occurred and to collect details.
Arrived at check-in Chancery Square and Freyberg Square, all clear.
Obtained a photo of the two teenagers who stole from High Street Supermarket; both wore hats and their faces were not clear. (Photo on file.)
Response message from Will at BNZ regarding a male individual who attempted to break into their carpark, last seen heading towards Britomart; making our way there to see if they need any support.
Arrived and spoke with one of their guards at North Face, offering our assistance and services if needed.
Response message from Edward and Jared regarding antisocial behaviour by a group near 171 Queen Street.
Called Jared to confirm; stood down — the group had moved on and were construction workers.

Heading into lunch break. Response message received from Giapo requesting assistance to ask a female vagrant on the street to turn down her music.
Arrived at the response call; staff informed us she had already moved along.
Lunch break completed; standing by for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 2 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key.
Arrived outside Noel Leeming; welfare check, all clear. Remained on standby outside Noel Leeming for nearby response calls while monitoring for problematic individuals and disturbances:
Departed the standby area; no incidents, problematic individuals or response calls reported.

Arrived at Hallensteins and spoke with staff, who reported an attempted shoplifting incident involving a group of minors at approximately 12:00; staff successfully prevented the theft. After being shown a photograph, staff identified the individuals as the same group reportedly involved in a theft at Auckland Supermarket earlier that morning.
Arrived at Vulcan Lane and conducted welfare checks on businesses within the area, all clear.
Arrived at Pocket Park and completed a security check, all clear.

Arrived at Fort Street and conducted welfare checks on surrounding businesses, all clear. Maintained a visible security presence after observing two male juveniles on bicycles who appeared to be the same individuals involved in the previous day's Romanis Cafe incident, where customers had reportedly been pressured to purchase food for them.
Continued standby at Fort Street while monitoring the two individuals and the surrounding businesses.
Response call from BNZ Queen Street regarding a female individual known for playing excessively loud music outside businesses; departed Fort Street and proceeded immediately to the location.
Arrived at BNZ and approached the female individual; instructed her to move away from the premises, but she refused to comply. Remained on-site and continued attempting to resolve the disturbance.

A passing Police officer attended the area and assisted with the situation. Upon noticing the officer's presence, the female individual stood up and moved along. Remained on standby to ensure the situation was resolved.

Information received from management regarding an incident at Radisson RED Hotel involving a male who had reportedly attempted to steal a candy jar and thrown its contents onto the floor. Management requested that the team remain alert for the individual and advise him he was trespassed if located; acknowledged and continued monitoring for the person of interest.
Departed the BNZ standby area following resolution of the disturbance.
Arrived at TK Square and commenced welfare checks on surrounding businesses.
Completed welfare checks at TK Square, all clear. Remained on standby while maintaining security presence and monitoring for potential disturbances.
Response call from Farmers requesting assistance with removing a male individual begging outside the store; proceeded to the location.

Arrived at Farmers and located the individual outside the premises; approached and instructed him to move along, and he complied without incident. Resumed patrols towards the upper section of Victoria Street West.
Arrived at the intersection of Albert Street and Victoria Street West; welfare checks on businesses along Victoria Street West between Queen Street and Albert Street, all clear.
Arrived at the upper section of Victoria Street West; welfare checks on surrounding businesses, all clear. Maintained a visible security presence for businesses and members of the public.
Departed the standby area; no incidents occurred.
Arrived at Aotea Square and commenced welfare checks on surrounding businesses.
Completed welfare checks at Aotea Square, all clear. Remained on standby to provide assistance to businesses and members of the public if required.
Continued standby at Aotea Square while maintaining a visible security presence.
Departed the standby area; no incidents occurred.
Arrived at Rutland Street and conducted welfare checks on surrounding businesses, all clear.
Arrived at Auckland Central Library and completed a security check, all clear.
Arrived at Lorne Street and commenced welfare checks on surrounding businesses.

Arrived at Radisson RED Hotel and maintained a visible security presence following the earlier incident reported by management; remained alert for the individual to advise him of the trespass notice if located.
Continued standby outside Radisson RED Hotel; no further incidents reported.
Departed the standby area; no issues occurred and the reported individual was not observed.
Returned to HQ to charge the Ops Phone due to low battery; battery percentage displayed on the office camera.
Commenced scheduled floor checks at HQ.
Arrived at Freyberg Square and Chancery Square; welfare checks on businesses along High Street between Freyberg Square and Victoria Street East, all clear.

Completed welfare checks on businesses within Chancery Square, no issues reported. Maintained a visible security presence for restaurant customers and surrounding businesses while monitoring for problematic individuals and vagrants.
Departed the standby area; no incidents occurred.
Arrived at Vulcan Lane and conducted welfare checks on surrounding businesses, all clear. Maintained a visible security presence for customers and businesses.
Departed the standby area; no incidents occurred.

While patrolling along High Street towards Fort Street, encountered a well-known male vagrant shouting and swearing in public; maintained observation due to concerns he might disturb nearby businesses or customers.
Arrived at Fort Street; the same individual had moved into the area. Remained on standby and continued monitoring his behaviour.
While maintaining observation at Fort Street, witnessed the individual attempting to start a physical altercation with a bus driver; intervened to prevent the situation from escalating.
Approached the male and instructed him to calm down; he initially refused to comply but began moving away from the area. Continued monitoring to prevent further disturbances.
Successfully calmed the individual and prevented further escalation. Remained on standby at Fort Street to ensure the situation remained under control.
Departed the standby area; no further incidents occurred.
Arrived at the lower section of Albert Street and continued patrols towards Victoria Street West.

Arrived at the intersection of Victoria Street West and Albert Street; welfare checks on surrounding businesses, all clear. Maintained a visible security presence while monitoring for problematic individuals.

Arrived at the intersection of Victoria Street West and Queen Street; remained on standby for nearby response calls while maintaining security presence for the public and monitoring for potential disturbances.
Departed the standby area; no incidents occurred.
Arrived at Elliott Street and completed welfare checks on businesses along Darby Street, all clear.
Arrived at Elliott Stables and completed a security check, all clear. Remained on standby while maintaining a visible security presence.
Departed Elliott Stables; no incidents reported.
Arrived at HQ and commenced charging the Ops Phone due to low battery; battery percentage displayed on the kitchen camera.
Ops Phone reached sufficient charge to support patrols until shift handover; departed HQ and resumed patrols.
Arrived at Commercial Bay and conducted a welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, all clear.
Departed Commercial Bay and returned towards HQ for Night Shift handover.
Arrived at HQ and remained on standby awaiting the incoming Night Shift.
Afternoon shift concluded; handover to the Night Shift completed. Auror reports processed.

items: No distinct Night Shift log was recorded for this date — the raw log repeats the 12 October Night Shift record verbatim (template copy). The duplicated entries have been removed to preserve data integrity; the shift itself was staffed per roster.

flags: DUPLICATE?: Night Shift narrative (22:28–06:30) is word-for-word identical to Monday 12th October's Night Shift — template-copy suspicion; metrics for the night assume the events occurred as logged.
